hookText: Shaking at highway speed? You might be fixing the wrong thing.
ctaText: Not sure which? Send this to them — or bring it by.
onScreenTextPolicy: burned-in captions only via ffmpeg subtitle filter — never generated in-frame (Seedance/Higgsfield cannot spell; M10 preflight blocks generated text)
standingNegativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

storyboardBeats.narration: Shaking at highway speed? You might be fixing the wrong thing.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Driver's-POV-adjacent shot of a steering wheel from the dash, subtle vertical blur/shake vibration effect on the wheel rim, highway lane lines streaking past through the windshield, cinematic automotive commercial look, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Balance and alignment get mixed up constantly. They are different repairs.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Close-up of a wheel-balancing machine spinning a mounted tire, small clip-on weights visible on the rim edge, soft shop-bay lighting, slow push-in, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Shaking in the wheel at speed usually points to a balance issue.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of a small wheel weight being clipped onto a rim edge by a bare tool (no hands/fingers in frame), shallow depth of field, even key light, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Pulling to one side, or wear on just one edge, usually points to alignment.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Overhead/top-down shot of an alignment rack with laser-line sensors clamped to a wheel, vehicle raised on a lift, clean garage bay, slow lateral pan, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Not sure which? Send this to them — or bring it by. Nick's Tire and Auto, link in bio.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Wide shot of a tire shop garage bay interior, bay door partially open to daylight, tools racked in the background, no readable signage or branding in frame, warm end-of-day light, static hold, 9:16 vertical framing
